verified-002.bio: Building the payments infrastructure that processes ₹80,000 crore monthly. I write Go, think in distributed systems, and mentor the next generation of backend engineers. Occasional open-source contributor.

verified-003.bio: Training models that serve 1B+ predictions per day for 140M shoppers across Tier-2 and Tier-3 India. I care deeply about building AI that works for everyone — including users with 2G connections.

pf-arjun-kapoor.headline: Bollywood Actor • 3 Filmfare Awards
pf-arjun-kapoor.bio: National award-winning actor with 15+ years in Bollywood. Known for roles in 'Dil Se Dil Tak', 'The Last Storm', and 'Bharat Ka Beta'. Brand ambassador for multiple luxury labels. Co-founder of AK Films Production House.

pf-priya-sharma.headline: Playback Singer • 2× Grammy Asia Nominee
pf-priya-sharma.bio: Celebrated playback singer with over 500 songs across Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu cinema. My voice has graced films seen by millions across the globe. Founder of SwarRaga Music Academy, nurturing the next generation of classical vocalists.

pf-rohit-verma.headline: Indian Cricket Team Captain • ICC Test Ranking #2
pf-rohit-verma.bio: Captaining the Indian national cricket team since 2023. Three-time IPL champion. Scored 10,000+ international runs across formats. BCCI's Brand Ambassador and active supporter of grassroots cricket development programmes.

pf-ananya-singh.headline: Content Creator • 14M+ Followers Across Platforms
pf-ananya-singh.bio: Lifestyle, beauty, and travel content creator with a combined following of 14 million. Forbes 30 Under 30 — Asia 2025. Launched my own skincare brand 'Glow by Ananya' in 2024 which sold out in 48 hours. Creating authentic content that resonates.

pf-kavitha-nair.headline: Astrophysicist • ISRO Chief Scientist • Padma Shri 2024
pf-kavitha-nair.bio: Lead scientist behind India's Mangalyaan-3 mission and the Chandrayaan-4 lander. TEDx speaker with 8M+ views. Author of 'The Cosmos Within' (bestseller in 14 languages). Passionate about making science accessible to every Indian child.

pf-vikram-malhotra.headline: Founder & CEO, Malhotra Ventures • ₹4,200 Cr Portfolio
pf-vikram-malhotra.bio: Serial entrepreneur and venture capitalist. Founded 7 startups — 3 unicorns. Featured on Shark Tank India (Seasons 2 & 3). Chairman of CII's Startup Council. Invested in 60+ early-stage companies across fintech, healthtech, and deep-tech verticals.

pf-neha-gupta.headline: Fashion Designer • FDCI Nominee • Wills Lifestyle India Fashion Week
pf-neha-gupta.bio: Indo-fusion couture designer dressing Bollywood royalty and international celebrities. My label 'Neha Gupta Couture' has showcased at Paris, Milan, and FDCI Fashion Week. Sustainable fashion advocate — 70% of my collections use recycled or organic fabric.

pf-rajan-mehta.headline: Senior Journalist • NDTV • Ramnath Goenka Award 2023
pf-rajan-mehta.bio: Investigative journalist with 22 years across NDTV, Reuters, and The Hindu. Covered 4 elections, 3 conflicts, and the 2024 Himalayan flood relief operations. Ramnath Goenka Excellence in Journalism Award recipient. Author of 'The Ink & The People'. Press Club of India board member.

tips: Add a headline (e.g. "Senior Engineer at Google") — most ATS systems prioritise this
Include your city/country — location is a key recruiter filter
Add your LinkedIn URL — 87% of recruiters use LinkedIn to verify candidates
Write a professional summary — it's the first section ATS and recruiters read
Add more skills — you have 0, aim for 10–20 relevant keywords
